hoaxes.title: Google's Genie 4 lets subscribers export its worlds as Lego building instructions
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Genie 4 adds audio and two-minute consistent scenes, and reaches AI Ultra subscribers in the coming weeks.

hoaxes.title: Choosin' Texas gets a 25-minute extended cut to celebrate 25 weeks at No. 1
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Choosin' Texas has a record 25 weeks at No. 1 on the Hot 100, and Tate McRae debuted at No. 2.

hoaxes.title: Diablo 4 Season 16 adds a shop where players can buy hats for Tyrael
hoaxes.truth: Made up. The Season 16 test realm runs Oct 27-Nov 3 with War Plans Tactics, Tyrael's Boons and Horadric Items.

hoaxes.title: Apple's M6 iMac ships with a colour-matched desk lamp in all seven colours
hoaxes.truth: Made up. The M6 iMac has a 24-inch 4.5K display, comes in seven colours and starts at $1,499.
